summary:
Implemented the next Anton slice: Garage staging Counter Mode now shows a one-visit next-item card with the current need-to-buy line, source saved note, and thumb-friendly `Mark Next Staged`, `Copy Buy List`, and `Exit Counter Mode` actions. It advances the existing local-only staging state, updates Garage dashboard counts, and does not add schema or vehicle facts.

Verified:
- `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('garage.html','maintenance.html')`
- `Test-InternalLinks.ps1`
- `Invoke-SiteAudit.ps1 -Pages @('garage.html','maintenance.html') -Tag audit-v301-counter-next -SkipScreenshots`
- iPhone-width screenshot: `debug-screenshots/audit-v301-counter-next-mobile-garage.png`

Updated `AGENT_STATE.md`, `AGENT_BACKLOG.md`, `ANTON_ROADMAP.md`, `SITE_QUALITY_AUDIT.md`, and `ANTON.md`. Next safe slice remains real-iPhone review of the staging receipt, Counter Mode, final part-number handoff, quick kits, save/share wording, and iOS share sheet before adding larger inventory behavior.

Impact Score: 4/5
Visible Change: Garage Counter Mode now walks the iPhone user through the next need-to-buy item and can mark it staged with one tap.
Impact Reason: This makes the parts-counter workflow materially faster and clearer on iPhone while preserving the local-only/no-schema staging model.
